source.control: reimplementation reproduces bin/agree2.py with max abs discrepancy 0 over 92 arms x 2 windows x 7 fields
source.supersedes: results/p7_c31.txt (partial: 46/92 arms per window; values in it are otherwise unchanged)

D1_weighting.what: beta[i] in probe.jsonl is the MEAN over tensor i's beta groups (HF.py:346); agree2.py averaged those per-tensor means with equal weight
D1_weighting.fix: weight tensor i by its group count w_i

D3_ntot_cap.effect: the repo copy silently mis-infers n_tot for ResNet-34 weightwise (21,282,122)
D3_ntot_cap.cross_check: n_tot inferred from frac_neg denominators equals the torch parameter-shape count for all 12 (arch,dataset,granularity) cells

bootstrap.scheme: resample seeds with replacement within each rung; OLS of log10(y) on log10(m) over all resampled seed-points

rung_level_ci.scheme: OLS on the R rung-level geometric means; SE from residual scatter with R-2 df; two-sided t interval. Captures power-law misspecification, which the seed bootstrap cannot.

sign_tests._note: form-free test: count adjacent-rung local exponents shallower than -0.500 and sign-test. Does not assume a power law. drift: 18/20 shallower (p=2.01e-4), STEADY alone 10/10 (p=9.77e-4). |2p-1|: 14/20 (p=0.058), STEADY alone 5/10 (p=0.623) -- consistent with m^-1/2.

drift_estimator_robustness.note: agree2 drift uses only the two window endpoints; OLS uses all records in the window
